title: School Subjects
text:
My favorite school subject is English. We have English lessons on Monday and Wednesday. Our teacher is kind and she helps us a lot. We read stories and we write short sentences.

Math is my sister's favorite subject. She likes numbers and she is very good at adding. On Friday, she has a math test. She studies every evening before the test.

questions.text: How many days a week does the writer have English lessons?
When does the sister have her math test?
Why does the sister study every evening?
options: She wants to do well on the test
She wants to go to bed early

questions.text: How does the writer probably feel about the English teacher?
options: The writer is afraid of the teacher
The writer does not know the teacher
The writer is angry with the teacher

vocabulary.definition: a person who teaches students in a school
symbols such as 1, 2 and 3 used for counting
a short exam to check what you have learned

paragraph_translations: Mój ulubiony przedmiot w szkole to angielski. Mamy lekcje angielskiego w poniedziałek i w środę. Nasza nauczycielka jest miła i bardzo nam pomaga. Czytamy historie i piszemy krótkie zdania.
Matematyka to ulubiony przedmiot mojej siostry. Lubi liczby i bardzo dobrze dodaje. W piątek ma sprawdzian z matematyki. Uczy się każdego wieczoru przed sprawdzianem.
